author: IGN
description:
In today's Daily Fix:
Rockstar Games and Sony have revealed a pair of limited edition PS5 DualSense controllers with a GTA 6 theme. One is black, the other white, and have the GTA 6 logo and other designs etched into the controllers. Both will be sold separately for about $85. Pre-orders will open via PlayStation Direct on September 10th. In other news, the final Final Fantasy 7 remake game now has a release date. Final Fantasy 7 Revelations will drop on April 8, 2027 on Xbox Series X|S, PS5, and Nintendo Switch 2. And finally, Crimson Desert's first major story expansion will be available next month. It takes place after the main game has concluded, so you might want to wrap that up before diving into the new content.
title: GTA 6 Limited Edition PS5 Controllers Revealed - IGN Daily Fix

author: IGN
description:
​Think you know everything about Star Wars: Zero Company? Think again. Even the most seasoned fans can miss some of the galaxy’s best-kept secrets. There’s some heavy tutorialization in the opening few missions, so it can feel like the game has covered everything you need to know. But I’m 50 hours in, and still finding new things, including details about the Den's Lounge, how to use backup, the best way to complete operations, and more! So here are 7 things you’re overlooking in Star Wars: Zero Company.​
Timecodes:
0:00 - Intro
0:26 - Don't Overlook The Den's Lounge
2:00 - Your Backup Strategy Matters More Than You Think
2:49 - Don't Neglect Droids
4:04 - How to Perfect Your Order of Operations
4:42 - Run your Operations Before You Go Shopping Between Missions
5:39 - Crises Are Misunderstood
6:34 - Knockback Can Save You in a Pinch
7:30 - Outro
title: Star Wars Zero Company - 7 Important Things You're Overlooking

Medieval Paris, Where the Tolling Bells Herald the End

1499. Paris is engulfed in flames as monstrous creatures suddenly emerge from the shadows.

Trevor Belmont, the hero who defeated Dracula, ventures into the burning streets with his daughter, Rose Belmont. Armed with the legendary holy whip, the Vampire Killer, they hunt down the beasts bleeding from the looming castle.

Rose is soon swept up in the dark conspiracy that lurks beneath. Will she succeed in saving Paris from devastation?
